featured_reviews.name: Megha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid This Business at All Costs! Save Your Money!

Terrible after-sales service. They insist on full payment upfront, knowing they wouldn’t receive a dime if customers paid after seeing the final product. The quality of what they deliver is shockingly poor—nowhere near worth what you pay. Check out the video, and you’ll see for yourself—no one would believe this is a new product.

To make matters worse, the owner is completely unprofessional, refusing to acknowledge any mistakes and arguing endlessly. He clearly cares more about protecting his own interests than about customer satisfaction.

And now, the owner has even fabricated a new date for my son's birthday just to give a misleading response to my review. I genuinely wish him success in his ambition to build India’s biggest company in this field, but it would be wise to prioritize service quality and customer satisfaction over his inflated ego.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Megha,

We made a mistake taking your order and delivered it urgently for your son's birthday. After Birthday is over, you want return and refund with such lame excuses. It unethical and sad to how low can a customer can fall however, we make most premium neon signs in India. Our neon sign is GEN2 and Glueless tech. Minor scratches on Acrylic are standard as it goes thru a cutting and marking process however this does not have any effect on Neon Sign and we have sold thousands of such signs without any such complaints. However, you are unique customer who is angry to not get refund on the light especially when you complain one day after your son's birthday and 10 days after the sign was delivered. We hope you change your behaviour as a customer, customers like you will never let an Indian Startup grow in India! Thanks again for review and God bless you.
